d: Room of Marion Delorme in Blois, simply decorated. In the background balcony that opens up on a terrace. - Left entrance door. - On the right door adorned with quilted curtain. - Seats and table on which rich lamp is lit. - The evening is advanced. Marion in elegant robe, seat, embroidery. - The Marquis of Saverny, in vague costume of the time is standing near her.
Marion alone.
Marion and Didier.
Saverny, Didier, Marion.

Piazza a Blois. Osteria straight ahead of which tables and scranni. Left palace of the prevosto, at whose corner a light. Further back door of a small hotel. At the bottom the city in the form of amphitheatre. On a hill, scattered with houses, the towers of St. Nicholas. It is near in the evening. Groups of officers of the regiment of Anjou, including Brichanteau, in front of the inn, such as drinking, such as playing with the dice. Next to them Lelio, also drinking.
Saverny, and sayings.
Laffemas, restless bottom.
In the evening, the windows shine inside. Didier, wrapped in his cloak, the hat on his eyes, comes out thinkingly from the small hotel. Then Saverny, Brichanteau, Lelio, from the tavern.
Marion, coming from the hotel and sayings, then a captain with patrol of Archers, and People.
Marion, who strays back from the road and had left. Laffemas who follows her at a short distance, and said.

A park. On a rial at the bottom of the outside of the castle of Nangis, the old and the new: the old sharp sixth, with the large black gate parade, and surmounted by the weapons of the Nangis and Saverny family; the new brick corners of stone with sharp roof. - On the left winding path that descends into the park. - Straight ahead, entrance to a barn belonging to the same castle. - It is day. Saverny, completely transformed with fake beard, disguised as officer of the regiment of Angiò, and Brichanteau, who come both discourse - indiffemas.
Lelio, and the Comici.
Marion, and Didier.
Lelio, and sayings.
Saverny, restless, coming from the palace, and said.
Laffemas, then Marion, Lelio and the Comici. Later Didier and Saverny, then Arcieri, etc.

Old courtyard inside the fortress of Beaugency. On the right high door to sharp sixth, near which a stone bench. - On the left small door leading to the prisons. - At the surrounding courtyard of the crenellated bastions. - In the evening is close. Marion from the bottom, dressed in brown, very agitated, heading towards the small door to the right.
Laffemas from the door straight, and said.
Marion alone.
From the door to the left Didier and Saverny between four archers, then in due time the Prisoner.
Didier alone.
Marion, Didier.
Drum roller. ~ A Councillor; Archers with their captain carrying torches lit. ~ People rushing at the bottom curious. ~ Then Saverny from the small door to the left, and sayings.
